_comment: Function Point weight table (SCOPE-0.6.0.md PRD-003), the standard IFPUG CPM 4.3.1 values also published in the SISP v2.3 roteiro (public domain). Five function types: ALI/AIE are data functions (internal logical file / external interface file), EE/CE/SE are transactional functions (external input / external inquiry / external output). Each is weighted low/medium/high complexity — the complexity band itself is asserted by whoever counts, cited to a source, not derived from a DET/RET/FTR formula (deferred; see PRD-003-full-core's plan for why).
